The '''Doxxen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Doxxen tea]].<ref name="TheAbduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Doxxen tea]]|system=Doxxen [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Doxxen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-19.<ref name="TEA" />
